note: Axial hypotonia is a documented feature in DHX9-related neurodevelopmental disorder, though the primary cohort reports 7/14 (50%) rather than 70-85%.

evidence.text: In a cohort of individuals with heterozygous DHX9 variants, axial hypotonia was documented in 7 out of 14 evaluated individuals (50%).

source.title: Monoallelic variation in DHX9, the gene encoding the DExH-box helicase DHX9, underlies neurodevelopment disorders and Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease
